title: Hide product video controls in the app and website
summary: Keep product videos playing inline without the playback toolbar.

changes.detail: Removed native video controls and the obsolete mobile controls-menu configuration; disabled the YouTube embedded playback toolbar.
Preserved muted looping playback and mobile pause when leaving the video slide. Website video defaults to autoplay so shared previews remain playable without controls.

validation.detail: Pending validation. Native device and browser visual checks not yet run. No deployment performed.
